question: What was the magnitude of the earthquake that hit Guangxi on May 18, 2026?

steps.content:
[2026 Liuzhou earthquakes - Wikipedia] On 18 May 2026, two doublet earthquakes measuring Mww 5.0 and 5.1 (both measuring 5.2 according to the China Earthquake Administration) struck Liuzhou, Guangxi, China. [1][2] Two people were killed, six others were injured and nearly 1,000 structures were badly damaged or destroyed by both events.
[The complete Guangxi, China earthquake report (up-to-date 2026).] A 5.1 magnitude earthquake hit near Guangxi on the evening of May 18, 2026 at 21:44 local time (Asia/Shanghai). The center of this earthquake was located 20km northwest of Liuzhou at a depth of 10km under land.
[Magnitude 5.2 Earthquake in Guangxi, China Kills Two and ...] May 18, 2026 · On May 18, 2026, a magnitude 5.2 earthquake struck Liuzhou in China’s Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region, causing fatalities, building collapses, and widespread evacuations.

On May 18, 2026, an earthquake struck Guangxi, China, with a magnitude of 5.2 according to various reports. The China Earthquake Administration recorded it as measuring 5.1. 

FINAL: 5.2
